mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 PM, we are enjoying clear skies at Badger Prairie County Park with a comfortable temperature of 65 degrees and a waxing gibbous moon above. If you look up tonight at 7:43 PM, you can catch the ISS flying from the northwest near the high school toward the east over Fitchburg, reaching about halfway up the sky.

Mark your calendars for October 5, as the city begins its weekly fall leaf collection. Remember to keep loose leaves behind the curb and away from obstacles. Also, the Plan Commission will review several development projects at their meeting on October 5.
Today is packed with activities, including live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, the downtown farmers market at Hometown Junction Park, and trivia night at The Bogey Factory.

In our weekly police report, on September 5, an officer discovered multiple vehicles with cheese slices on their windshields throughout the city, which was identified as a social media prank called the dairy dare.
While Culver's is open until 10:00 PM, they are currently closed for a remodel, so there is no flavor of the day available today.
